title: Nurse burnout dynamics
goal: A clinical leader can see reinforcing staffing pressure and balancing recovery feedback.

rubric.must: All causal links visibly show polarity markers.
The staffing-pressure loop is visibly marked reinforcing (R).
The recovery-response loop is visibly marked balancing (B).
Curved arrows visibly close both feedback loops.
Variable labels are readable without overlap.

ideal.notes: Updated 2026-09-14 against exemplar visual-eval/exemplars/causalloop/ideal.svg (sha256 dd3e7464cebc). Delay hashes placed on their curve using the quadratic midpoint. Loop labels matched by polarity; unmatched source declarations are reported, not silently attached to the wrong loop. Footer and loop labels separated. Visually inspected at full size and across the case family; independent targets, not engine-output snapshots. Pending source correction: both recovery links are negative, so their cycle reinforces, contradicting the declared B1 balancing label.
